blocks.text: Department of Culture and Youth Affairs of Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev

K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin Madaniyat zhana zhashtar menen ishtoө bolumu universitytin studentterinin rukhaniy, adep-akhlaktyk, aestheticalyk zhana ar taraptuu onүguүүsuнө kamkorduk kөruүү boyuncha ishterdi alyp barat Madaniyat zhana zhashtar menen ishtoө bolumu 1997-zhyly Kyrgyz Republic now myyzamdaryn ylayik, BMUnun okumushtuular keneshinin No. 64 buyrugunun negizinde bekitilgen. Bolum university rectors, institutes, deans, departments, okuu bolumdoru, trade union yumdary zhana bashka bolumdoru menen tygyz baylanyshta ishmerduulugun ulantyp keluda. Bolumdun negizgi maksaty talenttuu zashtardyn bashyn biriktirgen chygarmachylyk bolum bolup eseptelet. Bөlүmdө student of yrdagandy, biylegendi, musicyk aspaptarda oynogondu үyrөnүүгө – үрүү chygarmachylyk iyrimderde zhana birikmelerde өz zhondөmdүүlүktөrүn Onukturuүgө mүmkүnchulүk alyshat. Myndan tyshkary bolum madaniy-masalyk ish-charalardan tyshkary talenttuu zhashtardan kuralgan student birikmeler menen tygyz ish alyp barat. Alar “Student Kenesh”, “Bishkek Mamleketik University Enaktas”, “Bishkek Mamleketik University Debate” club, “Yktyyarchylar” toptoru zhana bashkalar. Bolumdun dagy bir maksaty zashtardy rukhaniy zhaktan tarbiyaloo, an-sezimin bayyltuu, yushtruuchuluk ishmerduulugun zhogorulatuu zhana uluu-kichuugo tuura mamile zhasogo, koomduk zhailarda өzүn (tuura) alyp zүrүүгө үndоyt. Zhana oshondoy ele patriottuulukka undөө maksatynda T. Satylganov atyndagy philormoniyada, Opera zhana ballet theaterynda, Kyrgyz-Orus drama theaterinda, Seitek baldar borborunda өtulgon madaniy ish-charalarga active katyshyp kelebiz. Tazaloo, ireetke keltiru ishembilikterdi yushturuuda bardyk studentterdi zhigerdu katyshuuga, zhardam korsotuugo chakyrat (tarbiyalait). Zhashtardy yntymakka chakyruu, dostuktu bekemdөө maksatynda madaniy zhana sporttuk ish-charalar zhyl sayyn zhogorku dengeelde otkorulup turat. Studentterdin pikir kelishpestikterin aldyn aluu zhana bosh ubaktylaryn tuura koldonuu maksatynda, tegerek stoldor, debattar, iigilikke zhetishken insandar menen tynymsyz zholugushuular yushturlat. Kalktyn ayarluu katmaryna zhana kamkordukka muktazh bolgon zhetim baldarga, kop balaluu үy-bulolөlөrgө, mayyptarga, zhalgyz boy enelerge, ulgaigan adamdarga zhardam korsөtuү maksatynda kairimduulukka bagyttalgan yktyyarchylyk ish-araketter studentter menen birgelikte өtkөrүlүp kelet. translate into Russian
Department of Culture and Youth Affairs of Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev

The Department of Culture and Youth Affairs of the Bishkek State University (BSU) named after K. Karasaev organizes events aimed at the spiritual, moral, aesthetic and comprehensive development of students.

The department was founded in 1997 in accordance with the legislation of the Kyrgyz Republic and the order No. 64 of the Academic Council of BSU. It closely cooperates with the university rector's office, institutes, deans' offices, departments, educational divisions, trade union organizations and other structural units.
The main goals of the department:

Support for creative youth – the department unites talented students, giving them the opportunity to develop their abilities in creative circles and associations. Students learn to sing, dance, play musical instruments and participate in various cultural events.
Working with youth associations – the department actively interacts with such student organizations as: Student Council Dance ensemble "Enaktas" BSU BSU Debate Club Volunteer groups and others.
Spiritual and moral education – development of youth consciousness, improvement of organizational skills, formation of a respectful attitude towards elders and a culture of behavior in public places.

Patriotic education – students actively participate in cultural events held in: Philharmonic named after T. Satylganov Opera and Ballet Theatre Kyrgyz-Russian Drama Theatre Children's center "Seytek" and other institutions.
Social and volunteer activities – the department organizes: Charity events for orphans, large families, people with disabilities, single mothers and the elderly. Clean-up days and improvement events.

Developing friendship and cohesion – cultural and sports events, round tables, debates, meetings with successful individuals are held annually to prevent disagreements among students and teach them how to properly organize their free time.
The Department of Culture and Youth Affairs of the K. Karasaev BSU plays an important role in the formation of active, creative and socially responsible youth.
